newsitem.title: USA: Iwerks to buy back up to 300,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: Iwerks to buy back up to 300,000 shares.

text.p: Iwerks Entertainment Inc said Thursday its board had approved a program to buy back up to 300,000 shares.

"The board made this decision based on the price at which the company's common stock has recently traded," it said. "The stock repurchase program will also provide shares to be issued under the company's employee stock plans and thereby reduce dilution from such plans."
The company said the buyback program will end October 20, 1997, unless extended.
It said it had about 11.7 million shares outstanding.
Iwerks produces high-technology, multi-sensory entertainment attractions like ride simulation, two-dimensional and three-dimensional giant-screen theaters.
